purpose: Audit whether frozen legacy D/DL/DG probability artifacts can support a no-refit, strict-past-only S17 R4 comparison without treating legacy scores as evidence.
known_outcome_exposure: The legacy registry already records DL/DG solo 0.608847/0.612159 and a negative equal-average conclusion, and root has read it. Any later strict result is retrospective confirmation, never a fresh holdout or independent discovery.

frozen_checks.artifact_integrity: D, DL, DG key and probability files exist with exact frozen hashes, identical key tables, finite probability arrays, identical shape and per-row probability sum 1 within tolerance. No action or official score is calculated.
frozen_checks.architecture: s12_n3_source_split.py must use the same teacher/classifier hyperparameters and outer fit masks for DL/DG, with only source-specific column sets changed relative to D lineage.
frozen_checks.source_purity: DL excludes GFS/cross-source columns and DG excludes LDAPS/cross-source columns; common columns are source agnostic.
frozen_checks.chronology: Outer fit is idx < fold start; as in N7, dropping the first operating day must make fit-label availability strictly earlier than each first retained basis.
frozen_checks.prior_adjudication: Legacy S12-N3 is non-score-bearing in the S17 ledger, has no immutable predeclaration/current protocol, and future-other-fold policy selection cannot qualify.
frozen_checks.handoff: If all artifact/architecture/purity/chronology checks pass and no exact S17 comparison exists, READY_NO_REFIT_STRICT_R4_MATERIALIZATION; otherwise BLOCKED.

forbidden: Q3/Q4 outcome inspection beyond the disclosed legacy registry text
